text: ともだちに　うらまれてない　きみ？

structure.jp: ともだちに　うらまれてない
structure.en: aren't you resented by your friends

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: ともだちに　うらまれてない
patterns.explanation: The れる ending says the thing is done to you, and に shows who does it. ともだちに うらまれてない = 'aren't you resented by your friends'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows a state that is going on now; てない is the short spoken 'not' form. うらまれてない = 'not being resented'.
